title: Decision Schema
description: The standardized outcome returned by the PolicyDecisionPoint.

reason_codes.description: Machine-readable codes indicating why the decision was made.

obligations.description: Conditions that the Execution Broker must fulfill for the action to be valid.

policy_version.description: The version of the policy ruleset that generated this decision.

manifest_digest.description: SHA-256 hash of the tool manifest authorized.

evidence_digest.description: SHA-256 hash of the CanonicalAction payload evaluated.

decision_ttl_ms.description: Time-to-live for the authorization token in milliseconds.

correlation_id.description: Unique identifier tying the decision to the specific protocol request.
